$comment: Single source of truth. Every phase READS this; no phase re-decides what it contains. Secret VALUES live in .env.local and Cloudflare Pages env vars — only names appear here.

project.name: kenya-china-tea-summit
project.oneLiner: The Kenya-China Tea Summit 2027 is a three-day trade, investment and innovation forum in Nairobi connecting Kenya's tea value chain with Chinese buyers, investors and technology providers.
project.audience: Tea exporters, importers and buyers; agri-investors and financiers; processing and packaging manufacturers; agri-tech and logistics providers; government and trade-policy officials; researchers; hospitality and tea-culture professionals — across Kenya, East Africa and China.
project.$languagesNote: zh-CN is a likely phase-2 requirement given the audience. Build with hreflang-ready URL structure but ship en only until the client supplies translated copy.
project.$domainNote: Not yet acquired as of 2026-08-01. The canonical origin is the pages.dev URL until it lands; flip `domainAcquired` in src/_data/summit.js at cutover. See ADR-010.

stack.$note: Eleventy is a BUILD-TIME dependency only. The shipped site remains static HTML + CSS + vanilla JS with zero runtime framework, per the web-factory hard constraints. See ADR-003.
stack.cssStrategy: custom-properties + design tokens, no utility framework
stack.$cmsNote: Decap CMS deliberately deferred — it needs an OAuth proxy Worker and the client edits via the secretariat, not a browser. Revisit if the client asks for self-service editing. See ADR-006.

cloudflare.$authNote: wrangler is authenticated via OAuth as karanjabk@gmail.com with pages/d1/challenge-widgets write scopes. A scoped CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is only needed for unattended CI runs.
cloudflare.$cronNote: Cloudflare Pages Functions do NOT support cron triggers. The B4 queue-drain criterion is therefore re-scoped: leads are durable in D1 the moment they arrive, so nothing is lost when a send fails. A standalone drain Worker is only worth deploying if failed sends actually accumulate. See ADR-005.

email.$note: senderDomainVerified must be true before B7 can pass. Brevo → Senders → Domains, DKIM + DMARC live on kenyachinateasummit.com. BLOCKED on the domain purchase — see B-003.

turnstile.$note: siteKey is public and belongs in markup. Never ship 1x00000000000000000000AA.

imagery.$note: Never generate images depicting the client's real people, premises, products, or events. No fabricated speaker portraits — speaker cards use a typographic placeholder until the client supplies real photographs.

brand.$logoNote: Client supplied 2026-08-01, 5225x5225 JPEG on solid white. Emblem cropped to src/assets/img/emblem-{96,256}.png for header and favicon; full lockup at logo-600.jpg. A vector or transparent-background version is still wanted so the mark can sit on the dark footer — not blocking.

$colorNotes.why: brandGreenLeaf is ~2.3:1 on white and must never carry text. brandRedBright is ~5.3:1 — large text and graphics only. Body copy uses ink; links and accents use brandRed; headings use brandGreenDeep.

brand.$fontNote: Logo wordmark is a high-contrast Didone-style serif (KENYA/CHINA) over a wide-tracked serif (TEA SUMMIT). Pair a self-hosted serif display face for headings with a neutral sans for UI/body. Locked in D1.

registration.$note: The client has not supplied ticket prices. No price, deadline or inclusion may be published until they do. The form captures intent into D1 and sends a Brevo confirmation. Swap in a ticketing embed at src/_includes/components/registration-embed.njk when pricing lands. See ADR-004.
